title.en: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS
title.zhHans: Google 发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 与 Flash-Lite TTS

searchSummary.en: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS through Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, adding prompt-based voice design and line-by-line performance controls across more than 100 languages and dialects.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 通过 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS，支持提示词驱动的声音设计、逐句表演控制以及 100 多种语言和方言。

summary.en: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS through Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, adding prompt-based voice design and line-by-line performance controls across more than 100 languages and dialects.
summary.zhHans: Google 通过 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS，支持提示词驱动的声音设计、逐句表演控制以及 100 多种语言和方言。

narrative.en: The release expands Google’s speech-generation product line with separate creative and high-volume variants. Vendor and third-party launch coverage confirm availability, but production adoption and independent quality replication were not established by the evidence cutoff.
narrative.zhHans: 该发布通过创意型与高吞吐型两个版本扩展了 Google 的语音生成产品线。厂商材料与第三方发布报道确认了可用性，但截至证据截止日，尚未证明生产采用或对质量结果的独立复现。

text.en: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS through Google AI Studio and the Gemini API.
text.zhHans: Google 通过 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 和 Flash-Lite TTS。

text.en: Benchmark leadership and quality improvements are vendor-reported, and independent production adoption was not established by the evidence cutoff.
text.zhHans: 榜单领先和质量提升来自厂商披露，截至证据截止日尚未证明独立生产采用。
